selection_rationale: An all-3g fleet: 5 torpedo boats fire one coordinated 40-round salvo, and 3 cheap frigates add PD and coilguns to finish emptied or crippled hulls. Every ship is 3g, so the whole fleet can control the range and evade incoming torpedoes together.
formation_rationale: The cheap Picket frigates sit 60 km ahead as a forward screen. They take the first exchange and draw fire and torpedoes away from the corvettes. The five Stilettos form a loose 3D wedge behind them, about 40-60 km apart, so every ship is within ~100 km of the others for shared PD against torpedoes. The lateral and vertical offsets make it harder for the enemy to line up its spinal guns.
